newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end first Feb trading day calm.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end first Feb trading day calm.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Portuguese shares ended the first trading session of February calm in very light turnover of 4.5 billion escudos, far below the daily average in January of nine billion escudos. Dealers turned their attention to the U.S. FOMC meeting.
"Tomorrow should be calm, but liquidity will rise in coming days as the 1996 results season enters full swing," said one operator.

* The Lisbon bourse is taking a breather, waiting for the stimulus of 1996 results before resuming its climb, dealers said. "In 1996 the market rose mainly for macroeconomic reasons. This year it will grow for microeconomic reasons," said Nuno Thomaz, analyst of Lisbon broker Titulo Corretora. Jose Freire of Espirito Santo Research (ESR) said: "The market needs a fresh stimulus -- 1996 results."
